notes: The parts list says 3 hook-up wires, but the circuit image shows only two (blue: pin 2 to the breadboard, black: GND to the breadboard). I used two, since the image is the authority.

The pushbutton straddles the centre gap in columns 4 and 6. I assumed the two legs in column 4 are side 1 and the two in column 6 are side 2, so pressing the button joins GND (column 4) to pin 2 (column 6).

The breadboard image labels rows j to f above the gap and e to a below it. The catalogue puts rows a-e in the 't' bank and f-j in the 'b' bank. Hole names follow the catalogue: the blue wire is in 6b.i and the black wire is in 4t.c.
The black wire goes to the GND pin next to 5V on the power header. I mapped it to GND.1, which is an assumption.
No external resistor is used. The sketch enables INPUT_PULLUP on pin 2, so the internal pull-up does the job.
